description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book Topsail* Private Pool (Heated for Add’l Fee $50/night)* 4 Bikes Included* Golf Cart Included* Pet Friendly (Add'l $250, Max 2 dogs)* Window's Peak Overlooking the Water* Near Redfish Village, Johnny McTighe's Pub, and Blue Mountain Creamery* Miles of Bike Trails; 6 miles to Seaside* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is not available to adults under the age of 25. No Exceptions. *Welcome to your coastal getaway at Topsail! This beautiful 6-bedroom, 4-bathroom home is just steps from the beach and bathed in natural light—offering everything you need for a relaxing and memorable seaside escape. Inside, you'll find a fully equipped chef’s kitchen, perfect for preparing meals to share with family and friends. The home features a spacious master bedroom with a king bed, a second king guest room, a queen guest room, and three additional guest rooms—including two with twin bunk beds, ideal for kids or extra guests. This lovely home also welcomes pets, max 2 dogs. For moments of connection and nostalgia, enjoy thoughtful touches like a record player, a collection of vinyl, and classic board games—creating the perfect atmosphere for cozy evenings and unplugged fun. Outside, expansive balconies offer generous lounge space overlooking the private pool, inviting you to soak in the sunshine, sea breeze, and good company. Come make unforgettable memories at Topsail—your perfect beach retreat awaits!Bed Set-Up:Master Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom 1: King BedGuest Bedroom 2: King BedGuest Bedroom 3: King BedGuest Bedroom 4: Double BedGuest Bedroom 5: 2 Twin Bunk BedsArea Attractions: Gulf Front at Blue Mountain Beach Condo is located along the beautiful beaches of South Walton and on Scenic 30A near Grayton Beach, Seaside, and Watercolor. One will find some of the best restaurants and shopping areas of the panhandle, such as Stinky's Bait Shack and Bud and Alley's. The 27-mile bike path provides hours of fun and exercise for the whole family as you ride a safe and easy path from Blue Mountain Beach Condos to shops, art galleries, restaurants, Seaside, Watercolor, Grayton Beach or Topsail State Park, and other beach areas. Bike rentals are available and within walking distance at Big Daddy's Bike Shop. Enjoy a ride-along scenic 30A. Bike over to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery for some homemade scoops that will have your taste buds coming back! You'll have an array of dining options as well!The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
